title: Global Health Metrics: Mental disorders—Level 2 cause (GBD 2021)
publisher: Institute for Health Metrics and Evaluation
license_note: Use figures under applicable IHME terms; do not assume bulk redistribution rights for GBD exports.
method_note: GBD 2021 modeled estimates with 95% uncertainty intervals; mental-disorder DALYs are overwhelmingly YLDs because fatal burden is only directly assigned to selected causes such as eating disorders.

title: The global gap in treatment coverage for major depressive disorder in 84 countries from 2000–2019: A systematic review and Bayesian meta-regression analysis
license_note: Open access under Creative Commons Attribution (CC BY).
method_note: 149 studies from 84 countries; treatment rates modeled with Bayesian meta-regression. Low- and lower-middle-income data remain sparse.
